criteria.check: When the answer says the manuscript meets a venue requirement (page limit, abstract length, anonymity, format), the evidence shows that requirement measured from the project files in this turn (for example the compiled PDF's page count or a word count), not assumed from an earlier answer.
An answer that calls the manuscript ready to submit reports every requirement of the active submission profile, each as met, not met or not checkable. Leaving a requirement out is a violation.
For an anonymous submission, the answer states that author names, affiliations, acknowledgements, self-identifying citations and file metadata were checked, or says which of them were not.
If the answer shortened the manuscript to meet a limit, it lists what was removed or moved, and no citation, figure or result was dropped without being named.
